# Confidentiality
All conduct policies in the Employee Handbook apply to research staff. Research staff are also held to the following.
## Need to Know Information is shared on a need-to-know basis. Staff are told what their work requires and nothing more. - Projects may only be discussed with staff assigned to them. - Staff may not ask about projects they aren't assigned to. - Restricted material may not be shared with other Company staff unless the Lead Researcher has cleared them. - Research may not be discussed with anyone outside the Company, whatever they claim to know.
## Classified Material Some Company research is classified above a researcher's clearance. Staff who come across such material must: - stop reading it immediately; - not copy it or repeat what it said; - leave it where it was found, or hand it to the Lead Researcher; - report it to the Lead Researcher.
Staff who report classified material won't be disciplined. Staff who fail to report it will be.
## Outside Enquiries - Questions from colonists, officials, the press or anyone else outside the Company must be referred to the Corporate Liaison. - Staff may not confirm or deny anything, even when the person asking appears to know already.
## Ethical Concerns - Concerns about an instruction are to be raised with the Lead Researcher. - Concerns about the Lead Researcher are to be raised with the Corporate Liaison.
